decision: Keep isolated; nesting and source references work mechanically, but this combined prompt/schema variant regresses meaning.

edge_reviews.rationale: Remote married-name exception is a reference, not a locally established exception with known limits.
Previous-name exception points to the containing prohibition and retains documentary permission.
Older-than-one-year, DS-11 and unchanged-ID trigger belongs to the suspension duty.
Emergency permission and its trigger omit inherited older-than-one-year, DS-11 and unchanged-ID conditions; those survive only in source evidence.
Generally needing documents to change ID is explanation, not scope governing the notation duty.
Conditional duty to submit name-change documentation is represented as a prerequisite of the no-new-ID exemption.
Particularly a newborn is emphasis within the infant allowance, not a separate applicability condition.
Scope entry repeats support permission and an example; its compound target also contains the separate head-tilt allowance.
Failure to meet photo requirements correctly triggers requesting a replacement photograph.
Hairstyle acceptance is attached as an exception to the whole recency/likeness recommendation; source does not waive six-month recency.
Certificate timing caveat is descriptive context, not an applicability condition on the desire to reuse a photo.

findings: The desired previous-name exception is explicitly linked to the correct prohibition. Saved controls had no explicit links.
All six document alternatives survive final conversion with original list formatting reconstructed from passage IDs.
After correcting an experimental adapter mismatch, no baseline or qualification is refused. Original conversions are preserved.
Valid IDs and parent-specific linking do not validate qualification meaning. Six of eleven links are misleading and two remain uncertain in this source review.
Emergency permission loses the governing prior-year, DS-11 and unchanged-ID case from statement, scope_text and qualification; full source paragraph still contains it.
Recent-change exemption and a separate conditional duty merge into one baseline with a misleading prerequisite link.

The prompt is much shorter and some reference fields lose the original explanatory descriptions, including the context-versus-scope distinction. The experiment cannot isolate nesting from those guidance changes.
Both variants retain should; source references alone do not improve normative classification. Role and attribution invention was not observed in these two trial responses.
next_step: Retain the source-ID and parent-link mechanics in the experiment. Restore existing full-scope and separate-action guidance, and distinguish supporting context, a related duty, and a true qualification before another trial. Do not infer qualification roles from nesting alone.
limits: Known two-excerpt sample, one new call each, saved controls; manual source review is not a gold standard or population accuracy estimate.
